summary_1line: Duryodhana completes a grand sacrifice, invites the exiled Pandavas who decline, and later he and Karna vow future victory and the destruction of the Pandavas.

image_candidates.scene_text: A messenger bows before the Pandavas in the forest of Dwaita, inviting them to Duryodhana’s grand sacrifice while they sit in exile.
Bhima angrily declares that he will attend only when Duryodhana is cast into the fire of battle, while the other Pandavas remain silent.
Karna raises a solemn vow before Duryodhana’s court, promising not to wash his feet or eat meat until he slays Arjuna.
